trailhead.label: Grauno (the church of San Martino), the APT’s start

cautions: Mostly forest tracks and paths, with about 560 m of village streets in Capriana.
A long cobbled descent back to Grauno, slippery when wet.
Few fountains on the long wooded stretches: carry water for your dog.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
